name: native_tool_name_clash
about: An agent author gives the agent a framework tool with the same name as one of its tasks. Building the agent fails with a message that names the tool, before any call.
instructions: You help callers with their orders.

tasks.name: take_note
tasks.when: The caller wants to leave a note.

expect.build_error: the tool 'take_note' is offered twice on one agent
